Specifically, there is fusion between the raccoon paws and the motorcycle parts (license plate, handlebars, engine casing), where limbs appear to melt into the metal rather than gripping it. The checkered texture also lacks biological integration, appearing as a flat overlay on the fur strands. These structural and textural defects prevent a perfect authenticity score.
